source_statement: Abstraktionen erhalten jede für Semantik, History, Security, Recovery, Retry, Ownership oder Diagnose relevante Unterscheidung, sofern kein Verlustfreiheitsnachweis vorliegt.
Veröffentlichte Revisionen steigen monoton und sind eindeutig.
note: ADR-039 confirms stronger Master §§2.1/3.1: genesis 0, first commit 1, contiguous monotonic publication, invisible reservations and reserved maximum exercised; durable crash proof remains M5-22.

source_statement: Revision ist Transaction Time und bestimmt keine fachliche Precedence.
note: Unpublished reservations are invisible and cancellation does not create revision gaps; durable publication remains M5-22.

source_statement: Committed History wird nur durch expliziten Offline-Purge physisch entfernt.
note: Kanonische History-Frames und optionale Flags bleiben beim Rewrite identisch; nur ersetzte Segmentkopien werden nach WAL-/Manifest-Publikation und Recovery reclaimed. Logische History-Löschung bleibt dem expliziten Offline-Purge M7-15 vorbehalten.

source_statement: Historical Query bindet Daten- und Schema-Snapshot reproduzierbar.
note: Data-/Schema-Binding ist durch M3-05 belegt; M5-12 stellt die referenzierten History- und LayerSchemaSnapshot-Segmente nach erneutem Öffnen wieder her.

source_statement: Child sieht Parent höchstens bis `base_revision`.
note: HistorySpace inheritance uses fixed ancestor cutoffs; later parent commits stay invisible until explicit adoption. Explicit transfer implementation and provenance are M2-02a.

source_statement: Spätere Parent-Commits fließen nicht automatisch in Child.
note: HistorySpace inheritance uses fixed ancestor cutoffs; later parent commits stay invisible until explicit adoption. Explicit transfer implementation and provenance are M2-02a.

source_statement: Siblings sind ohne explizite Migration/Merge isoliert.
note: Quell-/Sibling-Isolation und Transfer-Semantik sind durch M2-02a/M4-05b belegt; M5-12 weist die dauerhafte Replay-Lineage nach.

source_statement: HistorySpace-Operationen ändern keine Schemaidentitäten.
note: HistorySpace inheritance uses fixed ancestor cutoffs; later parent commits stay invisible until explicit adoption. Explicit transfer implementation and provenance are M2-02a.

source_statement: HistorySpace ist der einzige Branch-Domain-Typ; `BranchId` existiert nicht.
negative_evidence: test:catalog::tests::history_space_root_and_parent_shape_are_validated (self-parent rejected);test:catalog::tests::history_space_catalog_rejects_missing_parents_duplicates_and_cycles (missing parent, duplicate ID, and cycle rejected);test:rustdoc compile_fail BranchId does not exist
note: HistorySpaceId with optional parent is the only branch-domain identity; no BranchId type is defined.

source_statement: Jeder layerfähige Record trägt genau eine LayerId; Layer ist orthogonal zu HistorySpace, Perspective und Security.
note: M4-04b verifies layer and perspective references against the selected revision-bound catalogs; M5-06 storage/import proof remains open.

source_statement: ContextPrecedence ordnet HistorySpace-Spezifität vor LayerRank; Perspective/EpistemicMode sind keine Ränge.
note: Ordering compares inverse ancestor distance before historical LayerRank; Perspective/Epistemic are guarded as partitions, never coordinates.

source_statement: Masking überschreitet weder Perspective- noch EpistemicMode-Partitionen.
note: Gate evidence confirmed 2026-09-30T16:47:58+02:00. Reference Mask projection rejects a mask across Perspective/Epistemic partitions and at equal precedence; full security non-interference remains M3-15.

source_statement: Layerrechte verändern keine fachliche Precedence.
note: Precedence uses only HistorySpace ancestry and historical LayerRank; authorization remains separate. Security-filtered non-interference integration proof remains M3-15.

source_statement: Jeder wirksame historische Schemastand bezeichnet genau einen aktiven Base-Layer.
positive_evidence: test:layers::tests::base_switch_is_a_new_atomic_historical_state_and_rank_revisions_keep_ids (old and new base designations remain in separate revisions)
note: LayerSchemaSnapshot stores the base ID and validates every post-state.

source_statement: LayerDefinition folgt `Active → Deprecated → Retired`; Retirement verhindert neue Records, erhält aber Definition und historische Records.
note: Lifecycle and retained schema definitions are validated here; write rejection and stored-record retention are follow-ups M4-05a.

source_statement: `base_layer_id` ist historisierte Projektschemadaten und weder hardcodierte ID noch Name.
negative_evidence: test:layers::tests::snapshot_rejects_duplicate_ids_symbols_and_future_definitions (unknown base rejected);test:layers::tests::schema_revision_preserves_layer_identity_symbols_and_history (symbol cannot change for same ID)
note: base_layer_id is stored on the versioned layer schema view; no layer name or ID is hardcoded.

source_statement: Der bezeichnete Base-Layer besitzt den eindeutig niedrigsten aktiven PrecedenceRank und kann während der Bezeichnung nicht deprecated/retired sein.
note: Only active layers participate in the unique-lowest-rank check.

source_statement: Jeder persistierte layerfähige Record trägt eine ausdrückliche LayerId; Decoder, Import und Storage setzen nie still den Base-Layer ein.
note: Wire decoding requires an explicit LayerId on all five layer-capable record families; import/storage proofs remain M5-06/M7-13.

source_statement: Base-Layer-Wechsel ist eine atomare Schemaänderung, erhält historische Bezeichnungen und verschiebt keine Records automatisch.
positive_evidence: test:layers::tests::base_switch_is_a_new_atomic_historical_state_and_rank_revisions_keep_ids (base, ranks, and lifecycle validated in a later immutable snapshot)
note: Model preserves old schema state and does not move records; transaction and no-record-movement proof remain M4-04c/M4-05a.

source_statement: LayerSelection ist `BaseOnly | AllActive | Explicit`; BaseOnly wird gegen den gepinnten Query-Schemasnapshot aufgelöst.
note: SOURCE_ERRATUM_M0-02; Resolver consumes one immutable LayerSchemaSnapshot; QueryContext and end-to-end snapshot pinning follow M3-07.

source_statement: RecordedAsOf, WorldTime, EventTime und AssertionValidity sind getrennte Typen.
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc compile_fail Revision cannot be assigned to RecordedAsOf;test:rustdoc compile_fail Duration, EventTime and AssertionValidity cannot be assigned to WorldTime
note: RecordedAsOf, WorldTime, Duration, EventTime, and AssertionValidity are separate types. Database publication checks remain with the future history reader.

source_statement: Inkompatible Timelines erhalten keine implizite globale Ordnung.
note: WorldTime has no global ordering trait; checked_cmp allows same-timeline order and rejects different TimelineIds.

source_statement: Intervallgrenzen verwenden eine einzige dokumentierte Halb-offen-Semantik `[start,end)`.
note: Half-open [start,end) boundaries are applied by assertion projection; query/schema unit resolution remains a later concern.

source_statement: Assertion-Records sind immutable.
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc compile_fail mutate_assertion;test:rustdoc compile_fail mutate_closure;test:rustdoc compile_fail mutate_retraction
note: Private fields and compile-fail examples establish immutable record APIs; lifecycle projections remain follow-up evidence.

source_statement: Close, Retract und Correct erzeugen neue Lifecycle-/Domain-Records.
note: CorrectAssertion exposes one prepared three-record set at a shared revision; invalid/stale targets return no prepared effect.

source_statement: Retraction bedeutet Korrektur auf Transaction Time, nicht World-Time-Ende.
note: Gate evidence confirmed 2026-09-30T16:47:58+02:00. Retraction changes visibility only at RecordedAsOf; independent WorldTime validity remains governed by the assertion interval.

source_statement: Proposition Equality besteht exakt aus Subject, Predicate, Value, Polarity.
note: M2-17 generated one-match and four single-component-mismatch cases; context, identity, validity, and revision remain outside Proposition Equality.

source_statement: Masking ist kein positiver oder negativer Fakt.
positive_evidence: artifact:crates/worlddb-core/src/mask_projection.rs (output is a subset of immutable assertions only);test:mask_projection::tests::exact_assertion_mask_only_hides_lower_precedence_candidate
note: Mask projection can only remove candidate assertions; Mask never enters assertion polarity or creates a fact.

source_statement: Mask wirkt nur gegen strikt niedrigere `ContextPrecedence`.
note: Higher-precedence child Mask filters an inherited Assertion; equal-precedence Mask is ineffective.

source_statement: Mask-Scope ist genau ExactAssertion, Proposition oder Slot.
note: Closed selector enum has independent matching rules for all three supported scopes.

source_statement: Ohne verbleibenden Kandidaten resultiert grundsätzlich Unknown.
note: Composed Mask projection removes all candidates and SingleValueReplace returns Unknown, never a fabricated negative assertion.

source_statement: EventMask ist keine EventRetraction und cascadiert nicht zu Assertions.
negative_evidence: test:doctest EventMask cannot be used as Assertion Mask;test:doctest EventMask is distinct from EventRetraction
note: Gate evidence confirmed 2026-09-30T16:47:58+02:00. EventMask controls only Event projection; typed APIs reject its use as Assertion Mask and keep EventRetraction independent.

source_statement: Fachoutcomes sind Known, Unknown oder Conflict; Technikfehler separat.
note: Known, Unknown, and Conflict are explicit outcomes; malformed schema/value comparison remains a typed technical error.

source_statement: Keine ResolutionPolicy verwendet implizites Last Write Wins.
note: Strictly higher context wins; equal-rank disagreement remains Conflict independent of ID, revision, and input ordering.

source_statement: Securityfilter läuft vor Masking und Resolution.
negative_evidence: test:candidate_scan::tests::authorization_filters_assertion_before_candidate_construction (field-denied and duplicate hidden assertion never enter lifecycle/candidate projection);test:mask_projection::tests::masks_need_selector_and_validity_field_rights_before_projection
note: QueryResolve, record and field rights gate assertions before lifecycle/candidate construction; unauthorized Mask fields gate before redaction.

source_statement: ReplacementBoundary ist nur für MultiValueReplace gültig.
note: Boundary policy is constructor checked; resolver applies only active MultiValueReplace boundaries.

source_statement: ReplacementBoundary kann eine explizit vollständige leere Menge erzeugen.
note: An active complete-set boundary can express empty; absent boundary never asserts an empty set.

source_statement: Resolutionausgabe besitzt deterministische kanonische Ordnung.
note: RawHistory rows use fixed RecordRef wire tag plus ID bytes; ResolvedView derives and canonically sorts contributors from the concrete outcome.

source_statement: Core-Value enthält weder Null, Float, JSON, Array noch Map.
negative_evidence: test:compile_fail Value::Null rustdoc example;test:compile_fail Value::Float rustdoc example;test:compile_fail Value::Json rustdoc example;test:compile_fail Value::Array rustdoc example;test:compile_fail Value::Map rustdoc example

source_statement: Equality ist typisiert und coercion-frei.
Decimal besitzt genau eine kanonische Darstellung.
Decimal-Scale ist nicht Teil numerischer Identität; Darstellungs-/Messpräzision liegt in Schema/Metadaten.
negative_evidence: test:schema::tests::decimal_precision_metadata_is_separate_from_numeric_identity rejects metadata on non-Decimal and empty metadata
note: Metadata fields are fractional decimal-place counts stored on schema/field definitions; they are not Decimal fields.

source_statement: CalendarPeriod ist 1.0 kein Assertion-Value.
`Value` besitzt kein globales fachliches `Ord`.
positive_evidence: artifact:crates/worlddb-core/src/values.rs Value has no Ord or PartialOrd implementation
negative_evidence: test:compile_fail requires_ord Value rustdoc example;test:compile_fail attempts_global_value_order rustdoc example
note: Normative location corrected to Master §3.2 by ADR-039.

source_statement: Domänen-IDs sind nicht vertauschbare Newtypes.
note: 51 UUID identity types are distinct newtypes; compile-fail evidence rejects cross-family assignment.

source_statement: IDs sind 128 Bit; Zero und All-FF sind ungültig.
note: IDs use fixed 16-byte arrays and canonical UUID text; Nil and All-FF are rejected.

source_statement: ID-Zeitanteile definieren keine fachliche Zeit oder Authentizität.
negative_evidence: test:ids::tests::rejects_noncanonical_text_and_invalid_uuid_generator_fields;test:rustdoc compile_fail timestamp_millis is not an EntityId domain API
note: RFC UUID versions 1–8 and extreme valid timestamps parse; invalid version/variant fail; no domain-time accessor exists.

source_statement: BranchId, SchemaVersionId und typgelöschte LifecycleRecordId existieren nicht.
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc compile_fail imports reject BranchId, SchemaVersionId, LifecycleRecordId, and SegmentId
note: All three legacy IDs are absent; SegmentId remains internal; the exact 51-type registry is checked.

source_statement: Persistierter/Wire-RecordRef ist eine geschlossene exhaustive Enum.
negative_evidence: test:record_refs::tests::unknown_record_ref_wire_tags_fail_closed;test:record_refs::tests::all_record_ref_subset_conversions_match_the_closed_memberships;test:rustdoc compile_fail RecordRef::Other, operational refs, string refs, and schema-ref erasure;test:wire_records::tests::deferred_unknown_noncanonical_and_malformed_record_refs_are_rejected;test:wire_records::tests::every_closed_archive_target_round_trips_and_archive_cannot_target_itself;test:wire_records::tests::every_record_ref_roundtrips_and_unknown_noncanonical_or_malformed_refs_are_rejected
note: All 24 RecordRef variants have unique fixed tags and exact wire roundtrips; unknown tags and malformed/noncanonical refs fail closed. Query/import evidence follows M3-09/M7-13.

source_statement: Evidence-, Provenance- und Lifecycle-Targets sind validierte RecordRef-Teilmengen.
negative_evidence: test:record_refs::tests::unknown_record_ref_wire_tags_fail_closed;test:record_refs::tests::all_record_ref_subset_conversions_match_the_closed_memberships;test:rustdoc compile_fail RecordRef::Other, operational refs, string refs, and schema-ref erasure;test:wire_records::tests::every_closed_archive_target_round_trips_and_archive_cannot_target_itself (self-target and unknown tag rejected)
note: Typed Evidence, Provenance, Lifecycle, Archive, and EventRelation subsets remain closed; the archive target decoder round-trips all 23 allowed types and rejects ArchiveTransition self-targeting.

source_statement: EvidenceTargetRef erlaubt ausschließlich die in §31.2.1 mit J markierten Varianten.
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc compile_fail Source, Evidence, and EventRelation are not EvidenceTargetRef variants;test:record_refs::tests::all_record_ref_subset_conversions_match_the_closed_memberships (ArchiveTransition is admitted);test:wire_records::tests::source_meta_decoder_enforces_the_closed_evidence_and_provenance_matrices (Source, Evidence, EventRelation rejected as targets)
note: Exactly 21 of 24 variants decode as Evidence targets; Source, Evidence, and EventRelation fail closed. ArchiveTransition remains admitted under the lifecycle family.

source_statement: Corrects verlangt dieselbe kompatible Recordfamilie und konkrete Lifecycle-Variante.
negative_evidence: test:source_provenance::tests::corrects_requires_same_concrete_family_and_provenance_rejects_self_loops (506 incompatible pairs and Self-Loop);test:rustdoc compile_fail Lifecycle-IDs cannot be interchanged;test:wire_records::tests::source_meta_decoder_enforces_the_closed_evidence_and_provenance_matrices (incompatible endpoints and self-loops rejected)
note: Wire decoder matches the constructor matrix for the tested Corrects pairs and rejects incompatible/self-loop endpoints; Assertion-slot, EventKind, and Transaction-Time semantics remain dependent on M2-15a.

source_statement: DerivedFrom- und ResultedFrom-Endpunkte folgen den geschlossenen Matrizen ohne Other-/String-Escape-Hatch.
negative_evidence: test:source_provenance::tests::derived_from_rejects_exactly_the_disallowed_from_families (Mask/ReplacementBoundary/EventMask from);test:source_provenance::tests::resulted_from_accepts_only_assertion_or_event_on_each_side (alle verbotenen Varianten auf beiden Seiten);test:rustdoc compile_fail EventRelation and Other escapes are absent;test:wire_records::tests::source_meta_decoder_enforces_the_closed_evidence_and_provenance_matrices (disallowed DerivedFrom/ResultedFrom endpoints rejected)
note: Wire decoder exercises closed DerivedFrom/ResultedFrom endpoint matrices and no escape hatch; historical relation semantics follow M2-15a.

source_statement: Kein Sentinel codiert Abwesenheit, Fehler oder Lifecycle.
note: Sentinel UUIDs and Revision::MAX are rejected; Genesis 0 and first commit 1 are ordinary typed values.

source_statement: Option, Result und Domain-Enum bleiben semantisch getrennt.
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc compile_fail None/Err cannot construct JobStatus;test:rustdoc compile_fail MigrationRunState cannot be assigned to TransactionState;test:rustdoc compile_fail AuditSequence cannot be assigned to Revision;test:rustdoc compile_fail closed enums have no Other
note: Option represents an optional owner, Result reports constructor errors, and closed domain enums represent transaction, migration, job, audit outcome, and commit-context state separately.

source_statement: Fremddaten umgehen keine validierenden Konstruktoren.
negative_evidence: test:ids::tests::rejects_noncanonical_text_and_invalid_uuid_generator_fields;test:rustdoc compile_fail SnapshotId does not implement PersistentId
note: Foreign values enter through validating constructors; SnapshotId cannot satisfy PersistentId. Published SchemaRevision membership remains a history-reader/writer check; follow-ups M1-17d, M3-14, and M7-13 remain scheduled.

source_statement: Handles/Transactions/Snapshots sind nur bei expliziter Semantik klonbar.
note: SnapshotLease is non-cloneable; duplicating a reader pin requires explicit fork_reader() registration.

source_statement: Es gibt genau eine projektweite Schemahistorie.
note: M2-03 reference model selects pinned Historical/Current/Explicit schema and fails closed for corruption; durable history and storage recovery remain later follow-ups.

source_statement: `SchemaMode::Historical` ist Default und nutzt SchemaAt(RecordedAsOf).
note: M2-03 reference model selects pinned Historical/Current/Explicit schema and fails closed for corruption; durable history and storage recovery remain later follow-ups.

source_statement: Alle Schema-IDs, einschließlich PredicateId, EntityTypeId, EventKindId, EventRoleId, EventAttributeId und LayerId, bleiben über Active/Deprecated/Retired stabil.
negative_evidence: artifact:crates/worlddb-core/src/schema.rs revise_lifecycle retains stable typed IDs and rejects lifecycle regression

source_statement: ResolutionPolicy ist Predicate-Semantik und historisiert.
note: Gate evidence confirmed 2026-09-30T16:47:58+02:00. Historical snapshot retains MultiValueOverlay while the later current schema carries MultiValueReplace for the same Predicate identity.

source_statement: PredicateDefinition enthält SubjectConstraint, ValueKind/ObjectConstraint, Cardinality, ResolutionPolicy, Constraints und Lifecycle.
positive_evidence: artifact:crates/worlddb-core/src/schema.rs PredicateDefinitionSpec and PredicateDefinition expose the required typed fields;test:schema::tests::predicate_constructor_checks_object_and_cardinality_policy_pairs

source_statement: Entity Object Constraint ist genau für Entity-Values zulässig und wird strukturell validiert.
negative_evidence: test:schema::tests::predicate_constructor_checks_object_and_cardinality_policy_pairs rejects missing Entity and non-Entity object constraints

source_statement: Single ist nur mit SingleValueReplace, Multi nur mit MultiValueOverlay/MultiValueReplace kompatibel.
Single verhindert nicht widersprüchliche Assertions; StructuralValidationError und ResolutionConflict bleiben getrennt.
positive_evidence: test:schema::tests::single_cardinality_is_only_schema_resolution_policy;artifact:crates/worlddb-core/src/schema.rs PredicateDefinition stores no assertion count or conflict suppression;test:single_value_resolution::tests::equal_precedence_disagreement_is_conflict_and_input_order_independent;test:schema_write_validation::tests::single_cardinality_does_not_suppress_conflicting_assertion_drafts
note: Schema cardinality remains structural and does not suppress contradictory Assertions; M2-08 exposes equal-rank contradiction as runtime Conflict. M4-04a confirms write validation preserves conflicting drafts.

source_statement: EventKindDefinition historisiert Rollen, Cardinalities, Attribute und Event-Time-Constraint vollständig.
positive_evidence: test:schema::tests::event_kind_schema_captures_roles_attributes_and_time_constraints;artifact:crates/worlddb-core/src/schema.rs EventKindDefinition carries role, attribute, EventTime, lifecycle, and revision state
negative_evidence: test:schema::tests::event_kind_schema_captures_roles_attributes_and_time_constraints rejects invalid role bounds and CalendarPeriod on InstantOnly

source_statement: Deprecated Writes verlangen Opt-in, Capability und Warning; Retired verbietet neue Writes.
note: M4-09 confirms typed warning transport into the receipt; full NI/E2E closure remains assigned to M4-04c, M8-11a and M8-26d.

source_statement: Schema und Daten sind atomar; Referenzen validieren gegen das Post-Transaction-Schema.
positive_evidence: artifact:docs/M4-05-verification.md;test:write_reference_validation::tests::mixed_schema_domain_event_evidence_and_provenance_publish_once (staged schema and Assertion publish at one revision after validation against the post-transaction snapshot)
negative_evidence: artifact:docs/M4-05-verification.md;test:write_reference_validation::tests::mixed_schema_domain_event_evidence_and_provenance_publish_once (unknown Predicate in staged post-state is rejected before publication, leaving head at Genesis)
note: M4 integration proves shared publication and fail-closed post-state reference checks; durable crash/fault evidence remains M5-22.

source_statement: SchemaDependencies werden am Commitpoint gegen den aktuellen Head revalidiert.
note: Schema scope generations are revalidated; a writer can publish once while a stale reader receives ReadDependencyChanged. Five fixed seeded histories independently confirm the scope conflict outcome and exact replay.

source_statement: SchemaSnapshot ist derived/cacheable; Schemahistorie ist Wahrheit und Fingerprint ist kanonisch.
note: M2-03 reference model selects pinned Historical/Current/Explicit schema and fails closed for corruption; durable history and storage recovery remain later follow-ups.

source_statement: Schemaänderungen werden nach Auswirkung als kompatibel, restrictive oder breaking klassifiziert.
note: Impact mapping is closed; restrictive changes keep the stable identity.

source_statement: Bedeutungsinkompatible Änderungen benötigen eine neue Schema-ID; reine additive/metadatenbezogene Änderungen nicht.
note: Breaking changes require a new same-family ID; compatible and metadata changes preserve identity.

source_statement: Historical, Current und Explicit sind bewusste SchemaModes; keine stille Current-Coercion.
note: M2-03 reference model selects pinned Historical/Current/Explicit schema and fails closed for corruption; durable history and storage recovery remain later follow-ups.

source_statement: Beschädigtes benötigtes Historical Schema scheitert explizit und fällt nicht auf Current zurück.
note: M2-03 reference model selects pinned Historical/Current/Explicit schema and fails closed for corruption; durable history and storage recovery remain later follow-ups.

source_statement: Event und Assertion sind getrennte First-Class-Records.
positive_evidence: test:doctest Event cannot convert to Assertion
negative_evidence: test:doctest Event cannot convert to Assertion
note: Distinct immutable record types; no implicit conversion.

source_statement: Event erzeugt keine automatische Assertion/Inference.
note: Event candidate projection emits Events only; correction creates no Assertion or automatic inference.

source_statement: EventMask cascadiert nicht automatisch zu Assertions.
negative_evidence: test:doctest EventMask cannot be used as Assertion Mask
note: Event projection accepts only EventMask inputs and returns Event candidates; Assertion Mask is a distinct type and no cross-family cascade exists.

source_statement: Participants verwenden ausschließlich im EventKind erlaubte Rollen.
note: Unknown role IDs are rejected against the pinned EventKind.

source_statement: Role Cardinality und Required-Rollen werden strukturell validiert.
note: Minimum and maximum role cardinalities are enforced.

source_statement: Participant-Reihenfolge ist bedeutungslos; identische Role/Entity-Paare sind unzulässige Duplikate.
note: Participant ordering canonicalizes; duplicate Role/Entity pairs fail.

source_statement: EventKind-Schema bestimmt erlaubte/erforderliche Rollen, Attribute, Typen und Zeitconstraint.
note: Pinned EventKind definitions validate required/typed attributes, roles, and time form.

source_statement: EventTime ist Instant oder halb-offener Span; offene Spans schließen nur durch EventSpanClosure.
note: Instants, half-open/open spans, and closure are separately evaluated.

source_statement: Gleiche WorldTime erzeugt keine implizite Eventordnung.
note: Two distinct co-temporal Events remain distinct; EventTime creates no relation.

source_statement: Die Engine dedupliziert Events nicht automatisch.
note: Same-time original and replacement remain separately visible; no event deduplication.

source_statement: Witness impliziert kein Wissen; subjektive Erinnerung/Behauptung ist kein perspektivisches Event.
note: Witness/Event records cannot be implicitly converted to Knows/Believes/Claims Assertions.

source_statement: Eventkorrektur erzeugt neuen Event plus Corrects und mutiert/retractet nicht implizit.
negative_evidence: test:events::tests::event_correction_adds_new_event_and_corrects_edge_but_keeps_original_active (old Event stays active and no EventRetraction is emitted);test:assertion_correction::tests::correction_prepares_exactly_three_records_at_one_commit_revision
note: Event correction has its distinct two-record action; only Assertion correction adds an explicit target Retraction.

source_statement: EventMask ist keine Retraction, nimmt Wirkungen nicht zurück und cascadiert nicht.
negative_evidence: test:doctest EventMask is distinct from EventRetraction
note: EventMask controls only Event visibility; EventMaskRetraction restores it and EventRetraction is evaluated independently.

source_statement: EventRelation ist ein eigener immutable Record mit Before/After/SameTime/Causes.
note: EventRelation has its own immutable record kind and closed persisted relation kinds; After is an input alias only.

source_statement: Zeitwerte inferieren keine Eventrelation; Causes entsteht niemals aus zeitlicher Nähe.
note: Graph validation receives Event IDs and explicit EventRelations only; a valid Causes edge creates no Before edge.

source_statement: Event-Self-Relations sind unzulässig; SameTime wird symmetrisch kanonisiert.
note: Decoder reconstruction rejects self-edges; SameTime endpoint canonicalization is checked by canonical re-encoding.

source_statement: Der normalisierte Before-Graph und der separate Causes-Graph sind azyklisch; aktive Duplikatkanten sind unzulässig.
negative_evidence: test:event_relations::tests::post_transaction_graph_applies_retractions_before_cycle_validation (retracted old edge does not leave a false cycle)
note: The post-transaction Before and Causes graphs are checked separately; conflicts carry stable sorted Event/Relation identities.

source_statement: EventRelation besitzt keine World-Time-Validity und wird nur durch konkreten Retraction-Record korrigiert.
negative_evidence: test:doctest EventRelation has no World-Time validity interval
note: Only a separate later EventRelationRetraction changes active visibility; no World-Time validity member exists.

source_statement: `After(A,B)` ist nur Eingabealias und wird vor Equality/Persistenz zu `Before(B,A)` normalisiert; After wird nicht persistiert.
note: The event RecordKind stores only Before, SameTime, or Causes; the After input alias is normalized before persistence.

source_statement: SameTime wird als geordnetes EventId-Paar kanonisiert und als Äquivalenzrelation ausgewertet, ohne transitive Records zu materialisieren.
negative_evidence: test:event_relations::tests::graph_projection_builds_same_time_components_without_transitive_records (two explicit pairs yield one three-event component but remain two records)
note: SameTime equivalence is queried as components; transitive relation records are not materialized.

source_statement: Duplikatprüfung verwendet ausschließlich den normalisierten Relation-Key und erfasst dadurch inverse Before/After-Duplikate.
note: Duplicate detection uses the normalized logical key; a key can be reused only after the earlier relation is inactive.

source_statement: Der Before-Graph ist nach SameTime-Komponentenkollaps azyklisch; Before innerhalb einer Komponente und SameTime über einen Before-Pfad sind Konflikte.
negative_evidence: test:event_relations::tests::post_transaction_graph_applies_retractions_before_cycle_validation (post-transaction replacement validates after removing the former edge)
note: Before within one component and cycles created by collapsing SameTime components are distinct deterministic conflicts.

source_statement: Causes ist zeitlich orthogonal, impliziert kein Before und besitzt nur seine separate Self-/Duplikat-/Zyklusprüfung, sofern Schema keinen strengeren Constraint setzt.
negative_evidence: test:event_relations::tests::causes_cycles_are_checked_separately_and_do_not_create_before_edges (acyclic Causes relation yields no Before relation)
note: Causes has its own cycle check and never creates Before from either itself or EventTime.

source_statement: WorldState, Knows, Believes und Claims implizieren einander nicht automatisch.
note: Exact query partitioning; no automatic implication between modes or Perspectives.

source_statement: Fehlendes Knows/Believes und negiertes Knows/Believes bleiben verschieden.
note: Unknown absence remains distinct from explicit negative polarity.

source_statement: PerspectiveId und PrincipalId sind nicht austauschbar.
negative_evidence: test:compile_fail PerspectiveId cannot Principal::new;test:compile_fail PrincipalId cannot PerspectiveDefinitionRevision::new;test:candidate_scan::tests::authorization_filters_assertion_before_candidate_construction (same Perspective with an unrelated Principal receives no grant)

source_statement: Write/Write- und relevante Write/Read-Konflikte werden erkannt.
note: Disjoint writes commit from a shared base; overlapping write targets and changed present/absent read dependencies conflict. Seeded histories compare the allowed commits and conflict classes against the serial reference model.

source_statement: Range-/Predicate-Dependencies erkennen Phantoms.
note: Inclusive range insertion causes Conflict; predicate/schema/HistorySpace generations revalidate; deterministic seeded histories match the independent model, while disjoint outside-range writes do not conflict.

source_statement: TransactionConflict ist erwartbares Outcome, kein Storagefehler.
note: Conflict and UnknownCommitOutcome remain distinct typed protocol outcomes; validation error is not retried as conflict.

source_statement: Auto-Retry gilt nur für ReplaySafe ohne externe Side Effects und ist begrenzt.
note: Internal helper is crate-private, reuses unchanged input, retries conflicts only and permits at most two total attempts; user writes and migrations do not use it.

source_statement: UnknownCommitOutcome wird vor Retry über OperationId geklärt.
note: Unknown outcomes resolve through the same OperationId; unresolved calls are blocked and only proven NotCommitted permits same-payload retry. Durable recovery remains M5-22.

source_statement: Snapshot pinnt Daten, Schema, HistorySpace, LayerSelection samt historischen LayerDefinitionen und Securitymodus gemeinsam.
note: One immutable binding captures data, schema, HistorySpace ancestry/cutoffs, historical layer definitions, security mode/epoch and backend generation; scheduled and concurrent forks retain the same complete binding.

source_statement: Snapshot bewegt sich nie still auf eine neue Revision.
note: A later snapshot is separately registered; existing and forked leases retain the original revision and backend generation under concurrent registry reads.

source_statement: Gepinnte Segmente werden nicht reclaimed.
note: In-memory generation remains pinned through expiry while any parent or fork exists; deterministic release order drops the final pin only after its last owner. Concurrent duplicate pinning admits one owner and permanently rejects snapshot-ID reuse. Concrete file-segment reclamation remains M5/M7 backend evidence. M5-15 ergänzt durch prozessweit geteilte, typisierte Segmentpins und Reclamation nach verifiziertem Manifestwechsel; echte Backup-/Exportbindungen folgen M7.

source_statement: Engine- und Backendgarantien sind getrennt und testbar.
note: Engine-Validierung und Backend-Revisionszuweisung sind getrennt prüfbar; ungültige Eingabe erreicht das Backend nicht.

source_statement: Produktionscommit verlangt Machine-Durability.
note: ProductionStorage weist Memory, Process und fehlende Pflichtfähigkeiten zurück. Das synthetisch akzeptierte Machine-Profil belegt nur das Prädikat; reales Dateibackend und Plattformnachweis folgen später.

source_statement: SegmentId ist eine zufällige stabile Identität ohne Content-Semantik.
note: Each write gets an independent random registered SegmentId; M5-16 confirms manifest and recovery readback reject an envelope identity change separately from its content digest.

source_statement: ContentDigest hasht kanonische Segmentbytes getrennt von SegmentId.
note: BLAKE3 covers canonical format version, index and frames, excluding SegmentId and filesystem metadata; M5-16 verifies digest failure independently of envelope identity failure.

source_statement: Manifest, Backup und Recovery verifizieren SegmentId und ContentDigest getrennt.
note: Manifest und Recovery prüfen SegmentId und ContentDigest getrennt; Backup-Readback bleibt in M7-08/M7-10/M8-26d.

source_statement: Persistentes Format ist explizit versioniert und serde-implementierungsunabhängig.
note: All 47 record golden frames across 35 registered kinds and 3 separate audit frames across 2 audit kinds are canonical and pass production roundtrips plus the independent oracle; frame optional-bit behavior remains covered.

note: Nonminimal varints, duplicate/descending fields, noncanonical Decimal/sets/RecordRef tags, and unknown core/record/nested tags or fields are rejected; decoder budgets remain M1-18.

note: M5-04 belegt den zweiten Sync als Commitpoint; M5-12 belegt Restart-Replay, physische Crashdurabilität folgt M5-22.

note: Manifest bindet die exakte Commit-Hashrevision aus einer vollständig verifizierten WAL-Kette; ein Lag ist erlaubt, ein Zukunftsstand wird abgewiesen.

note: Windows/NTFS-Abnahme in M5-09 abgeschlossen; Linux/ext4 M5-08 und macOS/APFS M5-10 bleiben zurückgestellt.

note: safe_revision bleibt auf dem letzten vollständigen Commit; beschädigte Folgeframes und ein vorausliegendes Manifest werden nicht freigegeben.

source_statement: Uncommitted Tail wird niemals als Commit interpretiert.
note: Prepare ohne Marker und Torn Tail bleiben außerhalb des sicheren Commitpräfixes.

note: Sichere WAL-/Segmentkorruption sperrt alle Storage-Schreibpfade; der Verify-Bericht bleibt verfügbar und Recovery verändert die Originalbytes nicht. Quarantine ist ein read-only Zustand; physischer Salvage/Fork folgt M5-14.

source_statement: Recovery ist über wiederholte Abstürze idempotent.
note: Fünf persistierte Unterbrechungspunkte werden nach erneutem Öffnen idempotent fortgesetzt; dies ist ein deterministischer Restart-Test, keine Stromausfall- oder Prozessabbruchmessung.

source_statement: Salvage überschreibt nie das Original und berichtet Verluste.
note: Verified committed records are copied verbatim into a new marked fork with a digested loss/uncertainty report; source bytes are unchanged. Separate audit namespace is explicitly deferred to M5-18/M5-19; CLI import is M8-03.

Import remappt IDs nur über expliziten protokollierten Plan.
Purge 1.0 ist Offline-Rewrite, kein In-place-History-Umschreiben.
Secure Erase wird für SSD/COW/Backups nicht behauptet.
Streamende ist `None`; Konstruktion-, Item-, Cancel- und Budgetfehler sind getrennt.

source_statement: Öffentliche Errors enthalten stabile Codes und keine geheimen Ursachen.
negative_evidence: test:errors::tests::public_error_views_hide_secret_causes_and_preserve_typed_sources (the canary is absent from public fields and formatting)
note: PublicErrorDto is an explicit whitelist of code, message key, retry hint, OperationId, and JobId; secret causes have no DTO field. End-to-end IPC and renderer/log canaries are tracked at M8-09/M8-24.

source_statement: `source()` erhält interne Ursachen ohne sie öffentlich zu serialisieren.
note: InternalError<E> preserves a concrete source chain; public DTO and output do not serialize it.

source_statement: `Debug` öffentlicher/operativer Errors respektiert dieselbe Leak-Grenze wie `Display`.
note: Public/operational Debug prints stable public fields only and never includes the internal cause. Renderer-visible diagnostic canary review remains M8-24.

source_statement: Security-, Recovery-, Retry- und Public-API-Mappings sind exhaustive und besitzen keinen semantischen Catch-all.
negative_evidence: test:errors::tests::security_and_recovery_boundary_mappings_are_explicit (NotFound and Unauthorized collapse when existence is concealed)
note: Public codes, retryability, recovery actions, and security lookup mapping use exhaustive variant matches without a semantic catch-all.

source_statement: Niedrige Errors enthalten Error Facts; SuggestedAction/RecoveryPolicy wird an höherer Boundary entschieden.
positive_evidence: test:errors::tests::security_and_recovery_boundary_mappings_are_explicit (Storage error reports severity, retryability, and integrity impact)
negative_evidence: test:errors::tests::security_and_recovery_boundary_mappings_are_explicit (recovery action is selected separately at the authorized boundary)
note: ErrorFacts contains only Severity, Retryability, and IntegrityImpact; RecoveryAction is computed separately after authorization.

source_statement: Telemetriefehler blockieren keine Domainoperation.
negative_evidence: test:diagnostics::tests::queue_is_bounded_nonblocking_and_counts_drops_without_vetoing_work (full queue drops telemetry while the simulated domain operation remains successful)
note: DiagnosticPort::report has no error return, uses try_lock and counts full/contended/poisoned drops.

source_statement: Logs enthalten standardmäßig keine Values, Querytexte, Pfade oder Principalnamen.
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc diagnostics::DiagnosticField compile_fail rejects arbitrary query/string payload;test:diagnostics::tests::shown_and_hashed_values_are_explicit_and_events_are_bounded
note: Diagnostics accept only closed enum fields and allowlisted scalar values or explicit fixed-size hashes; raw strings, paths, query text, and principal names cannot enter the event DTO.

source_statement: Kein Sync-/Span-Guard wird über `.await` gehalten.
positive_evidence: artifact:crates/worlddb-core/src/diagnostics.rs (synchronous port, no span guard or async API);test:diagnostics::tests::queue_is_bounded_nonblocking_and_counts_drops_without_vetoing_work
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc diagnostics::DiagnosticField compile_fail rejects nonexistent DiagnosticSpanGuard
note: The Core diagnostics port is synchronous and creates no RAII span guard; async adapters must call it without holding a queue lock across await.

source_statement: Nicht klassifizierte Diagnosewerte sind `Omitted`; `Shown` und `Hashed` sind opt-in.
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc diagnostics::DiagnosticField compile_fail rejects arbitrary string values;test:diagnostics::tests::shown_and_hashed_values_are_explicit_and_events_are_bounded (shown/hashed paths require explicit constructors)
note: DiagnosticField::omitted is the default constructor; Shown and Hashed are explicit constructors restricted to safe typed values.

source_statement: Durable-Audit-Policyaktionen sind fail-closed.
negative_evidence: test:policy_audit::tests::required_audit_failure_blocks_policy_change_without_partial_effect (failed append leaves policy value, fingerprint, epoch, and audit records unchanged);test:wrong_required_audit_binding_does_not_publish_staged_policy_action;test:checksum_valid_but_mismatched_audit_record_quarantines_the_committed_prefix
note: M5-17 proves durable common-WAL fail-closed binding/recovery locally; full crash/fault coverage remains M5-22.

source_statement: Audit und Telemetrie besitzen getrennte Retention und Berechtigungen.
note: Audit retention and Read/Export/Configure capabilities are separately typed from fail-open telemetry. Durable retention/access enforcement remains assigned to M8-26d.

source_statement: Auditpflichtige Domain Action und Required Audit Record erreichen atomar denselben Commitpoint.
note: Required audit and action share one prepare/commit marker and sync boundary; semantically invalid binding is quarantined read-only. Crash matrix and equivalent contracts for restore/migration/export/purge remain assigned to later tasks.

source_statement: Reines Raw-Read-Audit verwendet eigene AuditSequence/WAL und erzeugt keine WorldDB-Datenrevision.
negative_evidence: test:durable_raw_pages_keep_retry_identity_and_use_an_independent_audit_sequence (CURRENT stays absent and the data WAL stays empty);test:process_exit_after_attempt_sync_recovers_an_attempt_without_claimed_output
note: Separate audit/LOCK and AuditSequence are independent of the data WAL and CURRENT; Windows-local evidence only, with broader durability in M5-22.

source_statement: Vor jeder Raw-Read-Seitenausgabe ist RawReadAttempt durable; Auditfehler blockiert Ausgabe.
note: Every returned page follows a successful synced audit commit; failed append blocks release. Later end-to-end audit evidence remains M8-26d.

source_statement: RawReadAttempt bindet Principal, Scope, Snapshot, SecurityEpoch und PageOrdinal ohne sensitive Nutzdaten.
negative_evidence: test:process_exit_after_attempt_sync_recovers_an_attempt_without_claimed_output (the recovered contract contains only attempt metadata and no output claim);test:partial_audit_tail_is_never_silently_treated_as_a_committed_attempt
note: Canonical RawReadAttempt contains only principal, opaque scope fingerprint, snapshot, current SecurityEpoch, page ordinal, and attempt identity; no raw payload fields exist.

source_statement: Retries besitzen neue AuditOperationId, behalten ClientRequestId und bleiben als Mehrfachversuche sichtbar.
negative_evidence: test:durable_raw_pages_keep_retry_identity_and_use_an_independent_audit_sequence (two attempts remain visible, proving retries are not deduplicated)
note: Retry identity and append-only multiplicity are checked across the verified audit readback.

source_statement: Auditwriter ist serialisiert, hält keinen Datenwriter über I/O und wird vor Raw-Reads recovered.
note: M5-19 proves recovery before a writer is exposed; RawReadAuditWriter owns only the separate audit lock and serializes its WAL. Crash follow-up remains M5-22.

source_statement: Korruption im committed Auditpräfix sperrt auditpflichtige Operationen und wird nicht automatisch repariert.
negative_evidence: test:m5_19_audit_recovery_contract::committed_prefix_corruption_is_read_only_and_byte_preserving (writer, read and recovery fail without changing committed bytes)
note: Primary recovery and committed-prefix corruption behavior is verified; M8-26d export/retention lifecycle follow-up remains open.

source_statement: Nur AuditCompleteBackup enthält und verifiziert Auditlog, Auditmanifest und deklarierte audit_safe_sequence.
Audit-Retention und -Zugriff sind policy-versioniert, separat autorisiert und selbst auditiert.
negative_evidence: test:m5_19_audit_recovery_contract::audit_read_export_and_retention_configuration_require_distinct_current_capabilities (missing capabilities denied, retention floor and current record count cannot be lowered)
note: Policy-versioned retention and separately authorized access have primary evidence; M8-26d audit lifecycle follow-up remains open.

source_statement: audit_safe_sequence ist vom WorldDB-safe_revision unabhängig; Raw-Read-Audit erzeugt keine künstliche Datenrevision.
Restore eines AuditCompleteBackup recovered Daten- und Auditnamespace separat und gibt Auditoperationen erst nach verifizierter Auditlineage frei.
Genau ein Writer publiziert; N Reader lesen gepinnte Snapshots.
negative_evidence: test:writer::tests::cloned_handles_submit_to_one_sequential_writer rejects maximum active writer above one;test:writer::tests::concurrent_snapshot_readers_hold_old_values_without_blocking_publish rejects partial or changed pinned snapshots
note: Single worker owns the executor closure; pinned immutable snapshots are read independently of publication; 256 commands from 8 concurrent producers, 8 readers.

source_statement: Kein Lockguard wird über I/O, Callback, IPC oder await gehalten.
note: Close paths release locks before handoff, callbacks and joins. Barrier-started SnapshotRegistry pin/fork/read schedules all complete within bounded channel waits without deadlock. M4-14c adds direct intake/cancel ordering and FIFO admission schedules; commitpoint tests preserve atomic all-or-none publication.

source_statement: Queues und Pools besitzen harte Grenzen und Backpressure.
negative_evidence: test:job_supervisor::tests::full_cpu_queue_applies_backpressure_and_keeps_registry_bounded rejects a third job at a full bounded queue;test:job_supervisor::tests::cancellation_is_cooperative_and_terminal_jobs_can_release_registry_capacity rejects admission at the tracked-job hard cap
note: CPU and blocking-I/O workers and queues have independent finite limits; saturated queues reject immediately and tracked terminal jobs retain capacity until explicitly forgotten.

source_statement: Cancellation nach Commitpoint macht Commit nicht teilweise rückgängig.
note: Cancellation is linearized against each backend-specific commitpoint; before it, the entire staged batch is discarded, and after it the backend completes the atomic batch. Durable crash/recovery and end-to-end adapters remain M5-22/M8-26d.

source_statement: Shared Handles werden mit `Arc::clone`/`Rc::clone` von kopierten Fachwerten unterscheidbar gemacht.
positive_evidence: test:writer::tests::cloned_handles_submit_to_one_sequential_writer uses Arc::clone for shared command handles;test:writer::tests::concurrent_snapshot_readers_hold_old_values_without_blocking_publish uses Arc::clone for shared publisher ownership
negative_evidence: test:rustdoc writer compile_fail rejects cloning DatabaseHandle without Arc
note: DatabaseHandle itself is non-Clone; shared lifetime is visible at Arc::clone call sites.

source_statement: Clone, `'static` und Taskownership dürfen keine ungeklärte Ownership kaschieren.
note: The job supervisor, writer coordinator, and database close owner have explicit owners; drop tests show intake closure, detachment, and no wait. M4-14c verifies admission closure, cooperative cancellation, FIFO drain, and the existing non-cloneable owner/handle compile-fail examples.

source_statement: Borrowed-to-Owned-Konversionen bleiben an Boundaries sichtbar.
note: The owner takes the supervisor and writer by value and borrows the telemetry flusher at close; no hidden static conversion is used.

source_statement: Indexresultate sind differential gleich zum Full-Scan-Orakel.
positive_evidence: artifact:docs/M6-13-verification.md;test:query_engine::tests::m6_13_seeded_scaled_indexed_queries_match_the_full_scan_oracle (3 seeds, 96 productive Indexed resolution/Explain executions);test:assertion_point_index::tests::point_and_both_history_indexes_match_full_scan_across_pinned_branches;test:record_indexes::tests::record_id_hits_and_misses_match_the_full_scan_oracle;test:record_indexes::tests::operation_id_hits_and_misses_match_the_full_scan_oracle;test:record_indexes::tests::schema_id_revision_and_history_match_the_full_scan_oracle;test:record_indexes::tests::lifecycle_history_and_type_safety_match_the_full_scan_oracle;test:mask_time_indexes::tests::mask_projection_composes_selector_validity_precedence_indexes_match_full_scan;test:events::tests::event_kind_role_and_time_indexes_preserve_reference_candidates;test:event_relations::tests::relation_index_returns_only_explicit_direct_edges;test:source_provenance_indexes::tests::evidence_neighborhood_matches_authorized_reference_and_hides_targets;test:source_provenance_indexes::tests::provenance_adjacency_matches_authorized_scan_and_drops_hidden_endpoint_edges;test:cargo test --locked --workspace --quiet PASS (438 Core, 82 Rustdoc);test:cargo xtask verify PASS (34 PASS, 1 expected SKIP, 0 FAIL)
negative_evidence: test:query_engine::tests::m6_13_seeded_scaled_indexed_queries_match_the_full_scan_oracle rejects the result after assertion ID 32 is deliberately omitted;test:query_engine::tests::m6_13_seeded_scaled_indexed_queries_match_the_full_scan_oracle confirms missing-index full-scan result equality;test:index_generation::tests::missing_corrupt_stale_or_incompatible_index_falls_back_completely
note: The exact confirmed statement was tested across every current prepared index family; productive Resolved/Explain point queries match the M2 oracle on three seeded scaled worlds. Missing-index fallback is complete, and a representative omitted indexed candidate is detected. Non-indexed search/graph/aggregate/raw paths remain explicit FullScan; paging uses its context-bound adapter stream.

source_statement: Staler/fehlender Index liefert nie still unvollständige Daten.
note: M6-01 proves generation validation and the safe selection contract; M6-08 must wire full-scan/budget outcomes into production query execution.

source_statement: Indexgeneration wird atomar vollständig publiziert.
note: Atomic publication is verified at six Windows process-crash boundaries; malformed catch-up or checksums never replace/expose an incomplete generation.

source_statement: Performanceoptimierung benötigt reproduzierbare Messung.
note: M6-14c records three repeated Windows query/history runs and the separately measured WAL/recovery run; Linux/macOS and cold-file/recovery-replay cases remain M9-07.

source_statement: Core hängt nicht von UI, konkretem Storage oder Observability-Adapter ab.
Core-Domainerrors verwenden keine universelle Error-Erasure.
note: Concrete public domain errors preserve typed failure identity in core; universal boxed error erasure is rejected by policy test.

source_statement: Produktionspfade paniken nicht auf falliblen Fremddaten.
note: Task panics become payload-free TaskFailure; writer maps to NeedsRestart. No production FFI or desktop renderer runtime exists yet; runtime integration is deferred until those boundaries exist.

source_statement: `unsafe` ist außerhalb des genehmigten Plattformadapters verboten.
note: Nur der Plattformadapter darf nach WDB-EXC-Freigabe Unsafe enthalten; aktuell gibt es keinen Unsafe-Code.

source_statement: Der kanonische Verify-Pfad ist lokal und in CI identisch.
Lokale Lint-Ausnahme besitzt ID, Owner, Grund und Ablaufdatum.
note: Register prüft ID, Owner, Grund und Ablaufdatum; es sind derzeit keine lokalen Ausnahmen aktiv.

source_statement: Crates werden nur nach bestandenem Boundary-Gate extrahiert; der Repositorybaum ist Zielhypothese.
note: Der reale Startgraph ist geprüft; weitere Crate-Extraktionen brauchen ein eigenes Boundary-Gate.

source_statement: Releasebuilds verwenden Lockfile und genehmigte Sources/Lizenzen.
note: M0-12 aktiviert die Policy; tatsächlicher Releasebuild und SBOM-Nachweis bleiben M9-09.

source_statement: Dependencytypen leaken nicht unabsichtlich in stabile Public API.
note: Core-Error-Erasure wird in M0-12 geprüft; der stabile Public-API-Diff folgt M8-01.

source_statement: 1.0 führt keinen untrusted Extensioncode in-process aus.
Desktopfrontend kann Storage/Dateisystem nicht außerhalb versionierter IPC umgehen.
note: Normative location corrected to ADR-018 by ADR-039.

source_statement: Core lauscht standardmäßig auf keinem Netzwerkport.
note: Normative location corrected to ADR-018 by ADR-039.
